newsitem.title: INDIA: India Gujarat Ambuja down 8 pct on BSE.
newsitem.headline: India Gujarat Ambuja down 8 pct on BSE.

text.p: Shares of cement maker Gujarat Ambuja Cements fell 18 rupees or 8.32 percent to 198.25 at mid-session on the Bombay bourse, traders said.
They said funds were sellers after several securities firms had sharply downgraded their 1996/97 (April-March) earnings forecasts for India's largest cement maker Associated Cement Companies.
"ACC's poor volume growth has worried fund managers," said a trader at a foreign brokerage firm.
ACC stunned cement analysts last week after it announced a 56 percent fall in its first half net profit to 550.5 milion rupees. The firm said sales volumes were higher by a marginal 2.4 percent.
"ACC's results are bound to impact other cement stocks," the trader said.
He said reports that cement prices had fallen in Bombay during the last week was also pulling the stock price lower.
Shares of Madras Cements were also trading 1,011.50 rupees or 11.6 percent lower at 7,701 rupees.
Madras Cements said on Saturday its net profit rose slightly to 459.1 million rupees in the six months to September 30, 1996 from 456 million a year-ago.
It said provision for taxation would be calculated only at the end of the year. The results fell below expectations.
